issue.description:
## Gate Execution Error

The gate command `git verify command-gate subject` failed to execute in workspace `/home/coding/bead-rs`.

### Error Details
- **Gate**: default_rust
- **Command**: `git verify command-gate subject`
- **Reason**: workspace HEAD changed from captured revision c6fefb2d7629a3fdb5c6838178128774b8aebfe4 to dac1672e8b41daf3d95adc20a489b1867fb75949 while verification ran
- **Consecutive errors**: 31

### Impact
This workspace is now **degraded**. Pluck and Explore strands will skip it for ordinary dispatch.
The workspace remains claimable for manual intervention or fixing this specific gate.

### Resolution
Fix the gate command (e.g., install missing dependency, correct path, resolve permissions) 
and the workspace will be automatically restored on the next successful gate run.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Gate command runs successfully
- [ ] No stderr errors (ENOENT, EACCES, timeout)
- [ ] Exit code is 0

### Verification
The gate command will be re-run on the next dispatch attempt. A successful run will:
- Clear the degraded state
- Close this bead automatically
- Restore normal workspace operation
issue.notes: Verified the landed fix rather than re-doing it. Root cause: the builtin default_rust gate archives the captured revision, runs cargo check cold (~16 min), then requires HEAD bit-identical across the window (GateSubject::verify_current) — this workspace's checkpoint automation lands .beads residue every few minutes when the fleet is active, so the precondition nearly never held (34 consecutive errors, degraded). Fix already at HEAD when I claimed this bead: 2be116b added .needle.yaml with a declared gates block (run_in: workspace, cargo check --all-targets --quiet), which replaces the language default. I confirmed needle gates resolves to exactly that one workspace-run gate, ran the gate command in the workspace (exit 0, no stderr, ~19s warm), ran the full DoD (fmt + clippy + test, no --fast) in a clean extraction of HEAD 9158eba — all green — and pushed through 9158eba so origin/main is current. Degradation clears on this closure's gate run.

issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-08ae90e5 (auto-split umbrella, R010 comment mutations). Spec landed at 54e79157; implementation landed after it at 67766fc8..6878c2ae (bead beadrs-2ddcb210). This child audits semantics and ledger behavior, not command surface (sibling children own that).

Scope (spec sections: 'Definitions', 'Validation rules', 'Audit events and event-schema impact', 'Revision and fencing interaction'):
Audit each clause against shipped behavior at origin/main HEAD (6878c2ae) from a clean 'git archive origin/main' extraction with a private target dir. Exercise the real binary in a DISPOSABLE bead workspace: create the scratch workspace with mktemp -d and cd into it in the SAME shell invocation (never probe against the live repo store); put TMPDIR under /data/build/scratch, never /tmp. Probe what the spec enumerates: validation rejects (empty body, over-long body, malformed parent or comment ids, unknown actor), audit event names and field shapes emitted by create/reply/resolve/unresolve (inspect the scratch store events and checkpoint output), fencing and stale-revision conflict behavior on a second write with a stale revision token, and resolution-state transitions including double-resolve and unresolve of a live comment.

Acceptance criteria (all required to close):
1. Per-section verdict recorded on this bead via 'bead update --notes' during the dispatch, with observed event names and the exact probe invocations.
2. Every DIVERGENCE owned: the full spec-side amendment text in the notes, or a proposal bead labeled proposal-pending and human, referenced by id.
3. No source changes; the scratch workspace is removed on success. A notes write during the dispatch is required even at zero divergences.
issue.notes:
Outcome: audit origin/main 6878c2ae comment spec Definitions, Validation rules, Audit events/event-schema impact, and Revision/fencing interaction. No source changes; no divergences found.

DEFINITIONS — PASS. Clean archive binary from origin/main was run in disposable workspace D=/build/bead-rs/beadrs-a123a0ba-ws.SnhAEN (TMPDIR=/data/build/scratch). Native IDs were comment-8bf2740e and comment-70c0fac1 (comment- plus 8 lowercase hex); root/reply rows preserved author/body/reply_to_id and explicit unresolved state. Body-file probe stored leading/trailing spaces and newline verbatim (author "  padded  ", body "  preserved body \\n"). Actor ladder observed: BEAD_ACTOR=env-actor, explicit --actor flag-actor overrides it, empty --actor falls back to system, nonempty padded actor is stored verbatim; unknown-principal is accepted because the spec defines no identity registry. Show --comments all returned canonical root-then-reply order.

VALIDATION RULES — PASS for all exercised rules. V1: from uninitialized U, `bead comment create missing-issue --body x` exited 3 with No workspace found. V2/selector precedence: `bead comment create audit-no-such-issue --body x` and same with --body "" exited 3, Issue ... not found. V3: `bead comment create audit-12512a25` exited 2; with --body inline --body-file D/one.txt exited 2. V4: --body "" exited 2, Comment body cannot be empty. V5: --body-file D/overlong.txt containing 4194305 ASCII A bytes exited 2, cap message. V6: invalid UTF-8 file exited 4; missing file exited 1. V7: --actor unknown-principal --dry-run --json exited 0; 256-byte actor exited 2; empty actor dry-run exited 0 as system. V8: reply --reply-to malformed-parent on audit-12512a25 and cross-issue reply on audit-c5b649cf both exited 4; both issue-selector precedence and no-row/no-event behavior observed. V9: resolve malformed-comment and cross-issue target both exited 4. V10 random collision exhaustion was not injectable; generated IDs were unique. Failed probes produced no comment rows/events or checkpoint comment records.

AUDIT EVENTS / EVENT-SCHEMA — PASS. Exact committed mutation invocations were: `bead comment create audit-12512a25 --body "root body" --actor alice --json`; `bead comment reply audit-12512a25 --reply-to comment-8bf2740e --body "reply body" --actor bob --json`; `bead comment resolve audit-12512a25 comment-8bf2740e --actor carol --json`; repeated resolve with --actor dave --json; and `bead comment unresolve audit-12512a25 comment-8bf2740e --actor erin --json`. SQLite events were sequence 3 comment_added actor alice detail {"comment_id":"comment-8bf2740e"}; sequence 4 comment_added actor bob detail {"comment_id":"comment-70c0fac1","reply_to_id":"comment-8bf2740e"}; sequence 5 comment_resolved actor carol detail {"comment_id":"comment-8bf2740e"}; sequence 6 comment_unresolved actor erin detail {"comment_id":"comment-8bf2740e"}. Event issue_id was audit-12512a25, times were RFC3339 UTC Z, and detail contained identifiers only. Double-resolve exited 0 with semantic_change:false and workspace_sequence 5; no sequence/event/row change. Checkpoint current object and forensic/object generations carried the same event kinds/details (checkpoint uses origin_event_sequence 3-6) and comments; no schema columns/tables changed. The later body-file create emitted a fifth comment_added sequence 7 with the padded actor and identifier-only detail.

REVISION / FENCING — PASS. SQLite issue revision was 1 before and after root/reply/resolve/unresolve and body-file comment writes; updated_at was unchanged until the independent update. Exact probes: `bead comment create audit-12512a25 --body x --if-revision 1` exited 2 unexpected argument; `bead comment resolve audit-12512a25 comment-8bf2740e --fencing-token stale-token` exited 2 unexpected argument. `bead update audit-12512a25 --status in_progress --if-revision 1` succeeded and advanced revision to 2; the second `bead update audit-12512a25 --status open --if-revision 1` exited 4 Revision mismatch expected 1 found 2. This confirms stale issue-row OCC remains independent from comment writes.

NO DIVERGENCES. V10 exhaustion was not directly fault-injected; all observable clauses and requested probes matched the normative spec.

Exact setup/probe paths: `git archive origin/main | tar -x -C SRC`; `(cd SRC && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build/bead-rs/a123a0ba-audit-target cargo build --release --locked)`; `TMPDIR=/data/build/scratch D=$(mktemp -d -p /build/bead-rs beadrs-a123a0ba-ws.XXXXXX); cd "$D"; bead init --prefix audit; bead create --title "Comment audit issue"; bead create --title "Other comment audit issue"`. Clean D and archive source extraction are to be removed after notes/verification.

Isolation incident: an initial child under /data/build/scratch walked into a pre-existing parent .beads store before detection; it created issues bead-0066ec4c and bead-ad1d2ab3 but no comment writes. I did not alter/delete that shared store. All comment evidence above is exclusively from the isolated /build/bead-rs workspace.

issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies a third dependency kind `verifies` so an author can declare that bead V checks bead I, and derives inverted-verification-gate diagnoses structurally from that declaration (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead). Field evidence in the ADR shows 21 and 24 inverted edges in two live workspaces. Nothing in the open-bead queue covers R025. Work: extend the dependency schema and CLI to accept the `verifies` kind while leaving section 3.4's two-kind cycle validation unchanged; add an advisory doctor report under the dependencies scope that names inverted pairs; never reject the edge at insert time and never infer the relationship from titles; cover the new kind in checkpoint round-trip, unknown-field, and concurrency tests; update `bead schema explain` / field-guide snapshots.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the `verifies` dependency kind (R025) with inverted-gate diagnosis

issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted, 2026-08-16) decides on a `ready_frontier` check in `bead doctor` under the `dependencies` scope that warns when open issues carry an assignee — a state excluded from the ready frontier and therefore permanently unclaimable — naming a bounded sample of offending ids and the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). The motivating sweep found 583 stuck issues across 47 of 66 workspaces with doctor reporting every one healthy; no open bead implements the check (beadrs-e1712892 covers the separate starvation fallback, beadrs-892eb8ce covers manual_blocked surfacing). Work: implement the advisory-only warning (doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`), bound the id sample, add regression tests for healthy / parked-assignment / mixed workspaces, and verify the check shares the readiness rule with the claim eligibility query rather than reimplementing it.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the ADR-005 ready_frontier doctor check for assigned-open starvation
